primary_metric: Exact match of all defect labels per scheduled case-run; format, transport and missing results count as incorrect.
design: Same model, task, observation and output schema in both arms. The skill arm additionally receives the frozen SKILL.md body and failure-modes reference. One independent request per observation; no conversation history. Each pair runs back to back with seeded random arm order. No automatic retries or post-result tuning.
limits: 24 author-constructed Chinese synthetic traces, not a public benchmark or blind external holdout. Two repetitions per case are correlated; bootstrap is clustered by the 24 cases. Tests explicit guidance loading only, not tool-use or trigger accuracy. Model route supplied by DMXAPI; underlying model identity is not independently verified. No estimate of monetary cost.
